body:
## Feature request

From @uchytilc in #5556:
> I saw this change in the change log and was wondering if there would be a way to revert the change via an option or something to allow atomic min/max to return the non-Nan value always. I have found this a very useful feature. For example it prevents the need to initialize different values when trying to find a max/min reduction (i.e. -inf vs +inf).
title: Add back support for atomics that always return the non-NaN values
